lab.title: Voice Lab
lab.description: Talk with Paxi and follow real API payloads from transcripts through the canonical case to the visible store projection.
lab.apiRequired: Start with npm --prefix code/apps/web run start:api. This lab needs the case backend on port 3000.
lab.demoCode: The prefilled public demo code works only with the dedicated start:voice-lab server. Otherwise use your local customer access code.
lab.baselineNotice: The baseline contains invented people and amounts. It is loaded as an unconfirmed draft.
lab.speaker: Speaking person (explicit attribution)
lab.replayNotice: Authored conversation across all eight fields, real backend writes. No microphone, speech playback or model call. Avatar activity is simulated.
lab.voiceConsent: I will use invented details only and consent to sending audio/conversation data to OpenAI for this voice demo.
lab.liveNotice: Continuous GPT-Live dialogue using your selected conversation skills. AI reads the conversation logs and updates captured details on the right. Live requires active extraction and both consents. Unclear statements are clarified; changes are accepted in the review.
lab.transcriptNotice: Live: GPT-Live fragments are submitted as client-settled on a speaker change or after 1.5 s quiet. This is neither provider-finality evidence nor playback confirmation.
lab.noTurns: Choose your conversation settings and start the live conversation.
lab.confirmationNotice: Captured details are proposals. Accepting them changes the draft; confirming the whole profile is a separate review action.
lab.noCase: No case loaded. Please sign in.
lab.traceNotice: Actual HTTP requests/responses, WebRTC data-channel events and explicitly local projections. SDP and credentials are redacted. At most 80 entries; large payloads are truncated. Audio packets and internal model payloads are not claimed here.
lab.extraction: Latest server-side extraction (model-v1 with AI consent, otherwise rules)

threePillars.title: The three-pillar system
threePillars.body: Swiss pension provision rests on three pillars. Pillar 1 (AHV/IV) covers basic living costs. Pillar 2 (pension fund), together with pillar 1, aims to maintain your accustomed standard of living to a reasonable degree. Pillar 3 is voluntary private provision for personal goals and gaps.

pillar1.title: Pillar 1: AHV/IV
pillar1.body: State pension provision is compulsory for everyone who lives or works in Switzerland. It pays pensions in old age (AHV), to survivors and in case of disability (IV). Today's contributions fund today's pensions. Missing contribution years reduce the pension.

pillar2.title: Pillar 2: pension fund
pillar2.body: Occupational pension provision is compulsory for employees above a certain annual salary. Employees and employers pay contributions, and the savings are built up for each person individually. At retirement it pays a pension, a lump sum or both. The benefits are shown on the pension fund certificate.

pillar3a.title: Pillar 3a: tied pension provision
pillar3a.body: Anyone with earned income subject to AHV contributions can pay in up to a legal maximum each year and deduct it from taxable income. The savings are tied up and available at the earliest five years before the regular retirement age. Exceptions include buying a home, becoming self-employed or leaving Switzerland for good.

pillar3b.title: Pillar 3b: flexible provision
pillar3b.body: All other private savings, for example in a savings account or in securities. There are no maximum amounts, and the money stays freely available. Pillar 3b usually has no special tax advantages.

gap.title: Pension gap
gap.body: The difference between the income you need in retirement, in case of disability or in case of death, and what your pension provision is expected to pay then. Its size depends on your goals and your situation.

consent.title: Before we start
consent.intro: Pax Digital Advisor helps you understand your pension provision across all three pillars. Please take a moment to read how it works.

recorded.title: What is recorded
recorded.body: What you say during the conversation is converted to text and stored together with the details you give about your household, income and pension provision. This data is used only for this advice.

ai.title: An AI is involved
ai.body: An AI assistant leads the conversation, asks questions and explains results. It does not calculate anything itself: all amounts come from Pax calculation tools. The AI only receives what it needs, without your name, full date of birth or health details.

extraction.title: Invented conversation excerpts go to OpenAI
extraction.body: Explicitly invented conversation excerpts and demo values are sent to OpenAI to extract unconfirmed field proposals. This does not release real data: real customer, financial or health data must not be sent to external AI models.

calculator.title: Invented calculation data goes to Logismata
calculator.body: Separately, invented calculation data is sent to the authorised Logismata hackathon calculator only after you confirm the complete profile.

demo.title: This is a demo
demo.body: This prototype from BaselHack 2026 works with synthetic data only. Please do not enter any real personal data.

human.title: A person is always available
human.body: You can ask for a human advisor at any time during the conversation: just say so. Complex or far-reaching cases are handed over to a specialist automatically.
